description: Ministry of Water Supply - Delta Watta, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Hunugala, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters for water supply projects. It involves the approval of acquiring specific immovable properties (land parcels) described in detailed schedules, including their boundaries, extent, location, and claimants. The content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, legal frameworks, commercial activities, or other specialized categories.
